items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: I had me and Pop Peet and tree trumpets and all of them... Billy Scott, Dan Hughes playing the car. They were all broadfinding in those days

ctx.x: And he had hot bands. Yeah. Which you'd call a jazz band.

Yeah, called ragtime bands. Well we used to play funerals and everything. Funerals. Over in Gretham. Yeah, funerals. Yeah. I had me and Pop Peet and tree trumpets and all of them. I had his colored doors. I forgot his name, Italian fellas playing baritone. Playing David. Billy Scott, Dan Hughes playing the car. They were all broadfinding in those days until now. Yeah, Dan Hughes. That got to be real stiff and sopractic. Oh, that was after. That was after, huh? That was after, huh, Dan Hughes? Dan Hughes, yeah,…
What kind of band did you use to play? I mean, how many bands did you use?
